name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, he initially pursued a career in the corporate world. However, a chance encounter with a former racing driver at a charity event ignited a passion for the high-octane environment of motorsport. He quickly realized his skills could be invaluable in managing the complex human dynamics within a racing team. 

At Reiza Racing Academy, Ricardo focuses on fostering a supportive and productive environment. He believes in a data-driven approach to HR, constantly analyzing employee performance and satisfaction to identify areas for improvement. He is particularly adept at conflict resolution and team building, ensuring that every member of the team feels valued and motivated. What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to blend traditional HR practices with the unique demands of the racing world, creating a winning formula for both the team and its individuals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his desk when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct one-on-one meetings while walking around the paddock, believing it fosters more open communication.
